name: react-module-federation
description: Contoh micro-frontend React dengan Webpack 5 Module Federation (host + 2 remote)

scripts.start: concurrently -n host,products,cart -c blue,green,magenta "npm:start -w host" "npm:start -w remote-products" "npm:start -w remote-cart"
scripts.build: npm run build -w remote-products -w remote-cart -w host
